project.name: cargotracker
project.description: Django-based cargo tracking application organized by domain-driven design (cargo, location, voyage, handling bounded contexts).

nodes.name: map_status.py
nodes.summary: Maps a cargo's delivery state to a status code string used by the tracking map frame.

nodes.name: tracking.py
nodes.summary: Application service TrackingLookup that finds a cargo by tracking ID and its handling history through repository abstractions.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root that wires Django repository implementations into the tracking view.

nodes.name: cargo.py
nodes.summary: Cargo aggregate root dataclass with identity-based equality and type-validated invariants.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Protocol defining the CargoRepository port for upserting and querying cargos.

nodes.name: tracking_id.py
nodes.summary: Immutable TrackingId value object wrapping a validated string.

nodes.name: forms.py
nodes.summary: Django form with a styled, required tracking ID field for cargo lookup.

nodes.name: eta.py
nodes.summary: Formats a cargo's estimated arrival time as a UTC string, hiding it for claimed cargo.

nodes.name: adapter.py
nodes.summary: Builds the URL of the map iframe with query parameters describing cargo status and locations.

nodes.name: next_activity.py
nodes.summary: Renders a human-readable sentence for the cargo's next expected handling activity.

nodes.name: status_text.py
nodes.summary: Produces user-facing status text from a cargo's transport status.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Factory creating the Django tracking view that handles the form, looks up cargo and assembles the template context, supporting HTMX partials.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: Root Django URL configuration routing admin, the tracking page and the tracking map URLs.

nodes.name: map_status_code
nodes.summary: Returns NOT_ROUTED, AT_DESTINATION, MISDIRECTED or the transport status for a cargo.

nodes.name: TrackingLookup
nodes.summary: Looks up cargo and handling history via injected repositories.

nodes.name: compose_tracking_view
nodes.summary: Builds the tracking view with Django-backed cargo and handling event repositories.

nodes.name: Cargo
nodes.summary: Aggregate root validating its components and compared by tracking ID.

nodes.name: CargoRepository
nodes.summary: Repository protocol with upsert, find and find_all.

nodes.summary: Frozen value object holding the tracking ID string.

nodes.name: TrackingForm
nodes.summary: Form with a required tracking_id CharField.

nodes.name: format_eta
nodes.summary: Formats ETA in UTC, returns None if claimed or '?' if unknown.

nodes.name: map_frame_url
nodes.summary: Builds the cargo_map_frame URL with status and location query parameters.

nodes.name: get_next_activity_text
nodes.summary: Describes the next expected activity for receive, load, unload or claim.

nodes.name: get_status_text
nodes.summary: Maps transport status to display text, delegating for in-port and onboard states.

nodes.name: create_tracking_view
nodes.summary: Returns a request handler that validates the form, finds the cargo and renders full or HTMX partial templates.

nodes.summary: Django ORM records for the cargo aggregate: CargoRecord (routing, spec, tracking state) and LegRecord (itinerary legs).

nodes.name: CargoRecord
nodes.summary: Django model mapped to the cargo table holding tracking id, route spec, delivery progress and foreign keys to locations, voyages and last handling event.

nodes.name: LegRecord
nodes.summary: Django model mapped to the leg table representing one itinerary leg of a cargo, ordered by load time.

nodes.name: history.py
nodes.summary: Builds human-readable tracking history rows for a cargo from its handling history, including whether each event was expected.

nodes.name: get_event_description
nodes.summary: Formats a handling event into a description sentence using its type template, location and voyage.

nodes.name: get_history_rows
nodes.summary: Converts a handling history into display rows with description, formatted time and expected flag.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Re-exports cargo ORM records so Django discovers them in the cargo app.

nodes.name: handling_event.py
nodes.summary: Domain model for handling events: event type enum and an immutable, validated HandlingEvent value object.

nodes.name: HandlingEventType
nodes.summary: String enum of handling event types, indicating which types require a voyage.

nodes.name: HandlingEvent
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass tying a cargo, location, optional voyage and times to an event type, validating type and voyage rules on construction.

nodes.name: handling_history.py
nodes.summary: Domain value object holding a cargo's handling events sorted by completion time.

nodes.name: HandlingHistory
nodes.summary: Immutable collection of unique handling events sorted chronologically, exposing the most recent event.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Defines the repository protocol for storing and querying handling events.

nodes.name: HandlingEventRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol declaring store, upsert and lookup of a cargo's handling history.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM record for handling events with foreign keys to cargo, location and voyage.

nodes.name: HandlingEventRecord
nodes.summary: Django model mapped to the HandlingEvent table storing type, dates and related cargo, location and voyage.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django-backed implementation of the handling event repository that persists events and rebuilds domain histories from ORM records.

nodes.name: DjangoHandlingEventRepository
nodes.summary: Implements HandlingEventRepository using Django ORM: stores/upserts events and maps records back to domain HandlingEvents.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Re-exports handling ORM records so Django discovers them in the handling app.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM record for voyages.

nodes.name: VoyageRecord

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Re-exports voyage ORM records so Django discovers them in the voyage app.

nodes.name: _LegSeed
nodes.summary: Plain data holder describing a seeded itinerary leg.

nodes.name: _EventSeed
nodes.summary: Plain data holder describing a seeded handling event.

nodes.name: _CargoSeed
nodes.summary: Plain data holder describing a seeded cargo with its route, legs and events.

nodes.name: _add_months
nodes.summary: Adds a number of months to a date, clamping the day to the target month's length.

nodes.name: _at_day_offset
nodes.summary: Converts a day offset from today into a datetime.

nodes.name: _cargo_from_seed
nodes.summary: Builds a Cargo aggregate with route specification, itinerary and initial delivery from a cargo seed.

nodes.name: SampleDataSeeder
nodes.summary: Seeds locations, voyages, cargos and handling events via repositories, then recomputes each cargo's delivery from its handling history.

nodes.summary: Django management command that wires Django repositories into SampleDataSeeder and seeds sample data in a single transaction.

nodes.name: Command
nodes.summary: BaseCommand subclass whose atomic handle() seeds the characterized sample data using today's UTC date.

nodes.summary: Value object for a single carrier movement between two locations with departure and arrival times, validated on creation.

nodes.name: CarrierMovement

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Defines the VoyageRepository Protocol port for voyage persistence.

nodes.name: VoyageRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol declaring upsert, find and find_all for voyages.

nodes.name: schedule.py
nodes.summary: Value object holding an ordered sequence of carrier movements forming a voyage schedule.

nodes.name: Schedule
nodes.summary: Immutable collection of carrier movements, validated in __post_init__.

nodes.name: voyage.py
nodes.summary: Voyage aggregate identified by its voyage number and carrying a schedule.

nodes.name: Voyage
nodes.summary: Aggregate root with identity-based equality and hashing on voyage number.

nodes.name: voyage_builder.py
nodes.summary: Fluent builder that chains carrier movements into a Voyage, linking each arrival to the next departure.

nodes.name: VoyageBuilder
nodes.summary: Builds a Voyage by accumulating movements via add_movement and validating inputs and non-empty schedule on build().

nodes.name: voyage_number.py
nodes.summary: Value object wrapping and validating a voyage number identifier.

nodes.name: VoyageNumber
nodes.summary: Immutable voyage number identifier with validation and string conversion.

nodes.name: RoutingStatus

nodes.name: Delivery
nodes.summary: Core delivery value object computing derived tracking state from route spec, itinerary and last handling event.

nodes.name: handling_activity.py

nodes.name: HandlingActivity
nodes.summary: Value object for an expected handling activity.

nodes.name: leg.py

layers.name: Domain Layer
layers.description: Pure DDD domain model: entities, value objects, and repository interfaces for cargo, handling, voyage and location.

layers.name: Application Layer
layers.description: Use-case services orchestrating domain logic, such as tracking, map status mapping and sample data creation.

layers.name: Infrastructure Layer
layers.description: Django ORM models, repository implementations, model re-export shims and database migrations.

layers.name: Interface Layer
layers.description: Web-facing code: forms, tracking views, URLs, templates, presentation helpers and management commands.

layers.name: Project Configuration & Wiring
layers.description: Django settings, root URLs, WSGI/ASGI entrypoints, app configs, composition root and package initializers.

tour.title: Project entry points
tour.description: Start with settings and the root URL configuration: installed apps (one per bounded context) and routing to admin, the tracking page and the map.
tour.languageLesson: Django settings are plain Python modules; INSTALLED_APPS lists each app.

tour.title: Value objects: identity and location
tour.description: The domain is built from small validated value objects such as TrackingId and UN/LOCODE locations.

tour.title: The Cargo aggregate
tour.description: Cargo is the aggregate root, composed of a route specification, itinerary of legs, and a derived Delivery.

tour.title: Voyages and schedules
tour.description: Voyages carry a schedule of carrier movements, assembled via a fluent builder.

tour.title: Handling events
tour.description: Handling events record what happened to cargo; the history sorts them by completion time and feeds Delivery.

tour.title: Repository ports
tour.description: Domain-defined Protocols declare persistence needs without depending on Django.

tour.title: Django ORM adapters
tour.description: Infrastructure implements the ports with Django models and repositories that convert between records and domain objects.

tour.title: Composition root
tour.description: Wires concrete Django repositories into application services.

tour.title: Application services
tour.description: TrackingLookup finds a cargo by tracking ID and maps delivery state to a status code.

tour.title: Tracking web interface
tour.description: The view handles the form, runs the lookup and renders status, ETA, next activity and history presenters.

tour.title: Embedded map
tour.description: A map iframe shows cargo markers from a LOCODE coordinate table, rendered by a template.

tour.title: Sample data and migrations
tour.description: A seeding service and management command populate demo data; migrations define the schema.
